records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2022 increased $216.2 million, or 18.9%, compared to the year ended December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Contribution from pricing actions and favorable product mix provided 16.3% of the growth, while higher volumes accounted for 2.6% of the growth.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Various macro factors, including, but not limited to, the COVID-19 pandemic, labor market trends, rising fuel and transportation costs, currency exchange rate, the conflict in Ukraine, the Avian Influenza and overall elevated demand for goods, have led to fragility in the supply chain.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Other expense primarily includes interest paid on our term loan offset by interest income earned on investments as well as a gain in 2022 from receipt of insurance proceeds under the representation and warranty insurance policy purchased in connection with the Voortman acquisition and the change in fair value of our liability-classified public and private placement warrants for the year ended December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income for the year ended December 31, 2022 was $220.3 million compared to $200.7 million for the year ended December 31, 2021.
